item.title: Dreams Speak in Symbols
item.description: Explore the hidden language of dreams and how your brain communicates during sleep. Discover the science behind dreams, the symbols that appear, and what they might reveal about your mind. A journey into the mysteries of the dreaming brain.

item.title: How Your Brain Stores Memories
item.description: Explore the intricate process of how your brain stores and retrieves memories. From encoding to retrieval, this episode dives into the science behind memory formation, the role of the brain's regions, and the challenges of forgetting. Learn how memories are shaped, why they can change over time, and practical ways to improve memory retention.

item.title: The Brain's Deception
item.description: Explore how the brain can confuse dreams with reality, creating false memories that challenge our understanding of truth and perception. This episode delves into the science behind memory reconstruction, the role of suggestibility, and the implications of false memories on our lives.
